patches.basis: The immutable repeat-only voice explicitly encodes both strains as count-one voltas, whose signs LilyPond 2.24 suppresses. Restore the opening and shared end/start repeat markers without changing any skip or note duration.

Make the already-encoded second-strain closing repeat visible at the original final barline. All canonical notes and 44 quarter-note units remain unchanged and must match the immutable published pitch/onset multiset.
